GuidePark1_Networked: There are three gazebos in the scene with rounded roofs. The one with the red roof is called Red-Roofed Gazebo, the one with the orange roof is called the Orange-Roofed Gazebo, and the one with the yellow roof is called the Yellow-Roofed Gazebo. The long stripe of blue running horizontal across the scene is called River. There are two bridges that cross River. The one on the left side is called Western Bridge. The one on the right side is named Eastern Bridge. There is a brown object named Boat that is placed in the River, in between the bridges. Next to Boat, there is another brown object that is half on the River and half on the green ground; this brown object is named Dock. Above Red-Roofed Gazebo, there is a structure that appears to be a pile of green cubes stacked on top of each other called Northern Platform. Another stack of green cubes is in the bottom of the scene, near the Yellow-Roofed Gazebo, called Southern Platform. A sqaure-shaped path stretches around the green park. Each of the corners of the path is also named. The one closest to Yellow-Roofed Gazebo is named Southwest Path Corner. To the left of this is the Southwest Path Corner. The corner above this, nearest to the Orange-Roofed Gazebo, is named Northwest Path Corner. The final corner , in-between the Red and Orange-Roofed Gazebos, is the Northeast Path Corner. There are a series of three brightly colored squares above the top of the path: these are called Northern Flower Patches. There is a series of four brightly colored squares below the bottom of the sqaure path: these are called Southern Flower Patches. Just below the Western Bridge, there is a brown rectangle which is named Bench. Right next to the Orange-Roofed Gazebo, there is a series of brown rectangles named Picnic Table. Directly in-between Red-Roofed Gazebo and Orange-Roofed Gazebo, there is a blue and gray structure in the middle of the path called Northern Fountain. Right below Eastern Bridge, there is a blue and gray structure in the middle of the path called Southern Fountain. Right below the River and close to the Western Bridge, there is a tall green cylindrical object named Pine Tree By the River. Right below the Bench, there is a rounded green object called Puffy Tree By the Bench. Near Southern Fountain, there is a group of rounded green spheres called Puffy Tree By the Fountain. By the Picnic Table, there is a rounded green object called Puffy Tree By the Picnic Table. Next to the Red-Roofed Gazebo, there is a cylindrical green object called Pine Tree By the Red-Roofed Gazebo. There are small groups of avatars scattered throughout the scene. There is a group standing on the path to the left of Picnic Table, named Northwest Huddle of People. There is a pair standing on the Southeast Path Corner called the Couple By the Yellow-Roofed Gazebo. There is a pair standing by the Northern Fountain named Couple By the Fountain.
GuidePark2_Networked: There are three fountains in the scene. One is a blue gray structure on the far right side of the park in the middle of a patch of grass, named Eastern Fountain. The blue gray structure to the left of this one is surrounded by a path and called Southern Fountain. The last one is a blue gray structure surrounded by brown rectangles in the top left part of the scene, and it is named Northern Fountain. There are four clusters of brown rectangles around Northern Fountain. The cluster on the top left is called Northwest Picnic Table. The cluster on the top right is called Northeast Picnic Table. The cluster on the bottom right is called Southeast Picnic Table. The cluster on the bottom left is called Southwest Picnic Table. There is a collection of round green spheres by these picnic tables named Puffy Tree by Picnic Tables. To the left of Southern Fountain, there is a structure that appears to be a pile of green cubes stacked on top of each other called Grassy Platform. The park in this scene is crossed by a variety of walking paths, that roughly form three sqaures of grass out of the park grounds. The grassy square that the picnic tables rest on has two corners above it. The corner on the very top left of the park is called Northwest Corner. The corner to the right of this is called Northeast Corner. Below this rests the grassy patch that Grassy Platform is part of, and the corner on the bottom left of this patch is called Southwest Corner. The corner on the bottom right is called Southeast Corner. In the third grassy square formed by the park paths, where Eastern Fountain is sitting, there are two more corners to the right of Eastern Fountain. The corner on top is called Far Northeast Corner. The corner on the bottom is called Far Southeast Corner. Above this final grassy patch, there is a small bit of path that juts off the main path and appears to circle a large green sphere. This green sphere is called Puffy Tree in Grassy Patch. At the top of the park, above the path above the picnic tables, there are three brightly colored squares named Northern Flower Patches. Below the bottom part of the park path, there are four brightly colored squares called Southern Flower Patches. To the left of the Grassy Platform is a brown rectangle called Bench By Platform. A little above this, and to the left of the path that leads up past the picnic tables, there is another brown rectangle named Bench Near Picnic Tables. Just below the Southern Fountain, there is a brown rectangle named Bench By Fountain. To the left of this bench, there is a group of green spheres called Puffy Tree by Fountain. To the left of this tree, there is a larger green sphere called Puffy Tree by Platform. Above this, there is one more green cylinder near the Grassy Platform called Pine Tree by Platform. To the right of the Puffy Tree in Grassy Patch, out in the grass off the path, there is a tall green cylindrical object called Pine Tree by Rocks. Between the Southern and Eastern Fountains, there is a green sphere called Puffy Tree Between Fountains. Situated in the Northwest Corner, there is a small black cube called Northwest Trash Bin. Right above Puffy Tree in Grassy Patch, there is another black cube called Northeast Trash Bin. Near the Southern Fountain and to the left of Bench By Fountain, there is another black cube called Southeast Trash Bin. On the far left side of the path immediately to the left of the Grassy Platform, there is a small black cube named Southwest Trash Bin. There are small groups of avatars scattered throughout the scene. One group is standing in the path to the left of the picnic tables, named Western Huddle of People. There is a couple standing in the grassy patch with the Grassy Platform, and they are named Couple by the Platform. There is a couple to the right of the Puffy Tree in Grassy Patch, and they are called Couple by Puffy Tree. Finally, there are five pieces of trash scattered throughout the park. One is called Brick and is a small brown rectangle. One is named Plastic Cup and looks like a white plastic cup. One is named Broken Bottle and looks like a brown bottle with the bottom half smashed off. One is named Toilet Paper and looks like a white roll of toilet paper. One is named Wine Bottle and looks like an unbroken, brown bottle.
GuidePark3_Networked: There are two gazebos in the scene with rounded, orange roofs. The one at the top of the scene is called Northern Gazebo. The one at the bottom is called Southern Gazebo. There are stone paths criss-crossing the park that split it up into roughly four different grassy patches. There is a blue gray structure in the bottom right grassy patch called Fountain. There are three light brown rectangles around the Fountain which are all benches. The bench to the left of the Fountain is called Bench by Fountain. There are two benches above the Fountain: the one on the left is called Bench by Couple and the one on the right is called Bench by Flower Patch. There is a brightly colored square to the left of Bench by Couple called Southwest Flowers. There is another brightly colored square to the right of Bench by Flower Patch called Southeast Flowers. In the grassy patch in the top right corner of the park, there is a light brown rectangle named Bench by Dancers. Above this bench, there are two brightly colored squares next to each other called Northwest Flower Patches. To the right of these, there are two more brightly colored sqaures called Northeast Flower Patches. Below the Northeast Flower Patches, there are two brightly colored sqaures called Southeast Flower Patches. In the middle of the stone path to the right of Bench by Flower Patch, there is a dark green sphere named Puffy Tree in Stone Path. In the grassy patch on the upper left side of the park, there is a light brown rectangle called Bench by Lamp. A little below and to the right of the stone path beneath this bench is a light green sphere called Puffy Tree by Lamp. By the Southern Gazebo, there is a cylindrical green object named Pine Tree by Southern Gazebo. Right beside the Southern Gazebo, there is a small black cube called Trash Bin. There are small groups of avatars scattered throughout the scene. To the right of Trash Bin, there is a pair of avatars called Couple by Southern Gazebo. To the left and a little above Fountain, there is a pair named Couple by Fountain. Near the Northern Gazebo, right to the left of the stone path coming from it, there is a group of avatars called Huddle of People by Gazebo. In the middle of the grassy patch with all the flower patches, to the right of Bench by Dancers, is a group named Dancing People. There is also a bench inside the Northern Gazebo called Bench in Gazebo. Parts of the stone paths in the scenes lead to dead ends. The part of the stone path right above Puffy Tree by Lamp is called Northwest Dead End. The part of the stone path right below the Southern Gazebo is called Southwest Dead End. The part of the stone paths that ends in the bottom right of the park, near the Fountain, is named Southeast Dead End. To the left of this dead end, where the path turns from the center of the park to go towards the Southern Gazebo, there is a corner in the stone paths called Stone Corner.
